name: Executioner (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): When the slayer performs a coup de grace, he treats his weapon’s critical multiplier as if it was one greater (causing weapons that normally deal x3 damage on a critical hit to deal x4 damage, and so on).

Advanced Options: Slayer Talents & Lethalities ©2014, Rogue Genius Games. Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
